t: Shello yegaheq velo yepaheq bishat hattepilla
s: Shello yegaheq velo yepaheq bishat hattepilla ubo h' seipim: lo yegaheq, dehaynu nepicha sheadam motzi miggupo lepiv mittok sobo. Velo yepaheq, dehaynu sheppoteach piv keadam harotzeh lishon o sheamad mishshena. Veim giheq o piheq lirtzono — hare zeh miggasse haruach. Im tzarik lepaheq mittok ones — yanniach yado al piv shello teraeh petichato. Velo yanniach yado al santero, dehaynu lechi hattachton, bishat hattepilla, mippene shehu derek gassut haruach. Vechazzanim haosim ken bishat hazzemer — muttar, lepi sheenam mitkavvenim legassut ella lehanim et haqqol. Abal shello bishat hazzemer — asur:

Haraq bitpillato — keillu raq bipne hammelek. Lepikak, asur laroq lirtzono shello meones apillu omed betachanunim shelleachar hattepilla, shekkol zeman shello pasa — hare zeh omed lipne hammelek. Abal im tzarik laroq — muttar, kede shello yitztaer battepilla venimtza tarud. Umikkol maqom, lo yaroq al gabbe qarqa apillu yesh sham gemi o teben sheyyekassu haroq, ella mablio biksuto beinyan shello yehe nireh, kegon babbeged hattachton, abal babbeged haelyon sheharoq nireh — asur. Ubimqomot shellobeshin bachagora chatikat beged (sheqqorin patziilat) — epshar shemmuttar lehablia bo ap al pi sheharoq nireh, shekkevan shehu asuy lekak — en bo mishshum mius. Veim hu istenis shemmaus alayv lehablio biksuto, o shemmaus alayv lehashhoto bepiv ad sheyyiblaennu (o shehu kesut naeh veim natzrikennu sheyyiblaennu yatridennu gam ken) — zoreqo laachorayv, abal lo lepanayv, mippene shehammitpallel shekina lepanayv. Utzedadin hem kilpanayv leinyan zeh. Veim i epshar lo lezorqo laachorayv — zoreqo lismolo, abal lo limino, mishshum shenneemar: "Hashem tzilleka al yad yemineka". Veim i epshar lo laroq ki im lepanayv — muttar kede shello yittared:

Im kinna oqatzto — yemashmesh bibgadayv lahasirah shello titbattel kavvanato, abal lo yesirenna beyado apillu hi bemaqom sheen sham milmule zea (sheen tzarik netilat yadayim litpilla, kemo sheen tzarik im naga bishar baale chayyim temeim), mikkol maqom meusa hi ugenay hu apillu im yirenna adam — qal vachomer kesheomed battepilla lipne melek malke hammelakim haqqadosh baruk hu. Abal shello bishat tepillat y"ch — yakol littol kinna ulezorqah bebet hakkeneset, kemo shemmuttar laroq bebet hakkeneset. (Vaapillu naga bemilmule zea) — day beniqyon apar lehazkarat hashshem o ledibre tora, kemo shennitbaer besiman d' vtz"b. O yittelenna al yede beged, lepi shemmishshum ruach raa sheshshora al hayyadayim hannogeim bakkinna — en niqqayon moil ella netila bemayim, kemo shennitbaer besiman d':

Im nishmat tallito mimmeqomo — yakol lemashmesh bo ulehachaziro, apillu napal rubbo. Abal napal kullo — eno yakol lachazor ulehitattep bo, mishshum hepseq (ella im ken shehu tarud al yede zeh veeno yakol lekavven):

Hannose massaoy al ketepayv vehiggia zeman hattepilla, pachot mid' qabbin — mapshilo laachorayv umitpallel, velo yochazennu beyado al ketepayv (kede shello yihyeh tarud bitpillato baachizat hammassaoy al ketepayv beyado velo yukal lekavven karauy, veod lipne melek basar vadam en omedin ken — qal vachomer lipne melek malke hammelakim haqqadosh baruk hu). D' qabbin — lo yapshilennu laachorayv, mippene shekkobdo moneo millekavven, ella mannicho al gabbe qarqa ad leachar hattepilla:
